description: Show the account behind your API key (Authorization: Bearer mp_live_...): its name, payment mode (invoiced for enterprise accounts) and GSTIN. massprint never messages your customers: tracking reaches you through get_order and your webhooks, and you tell your customers. Requires an API key. Enterprise accounts create and revoke keys at https://themassprint.com/business.
